notice: All data is fictional. Lysbro Pay ApS, its customers and every transaction are invented.

R1.name: Structuring
R1.how: At least 3 transfers between €8.500 and €10.000 within 7 days.

R2.name: Pass-through
R2.how: Money in from at least 3 senders (at least €3.000) and at least 80 % of it out again within 48 hours.

R3.name: Fan-in
R3.how: At least 8 different senders (small business: 25) within 30 days.

R4.name: Volume spike
R4.how: Volume in 30 days at least 4 times the larger of the declared monthly volume and the customer's own average month in the 90 days before, and at least €5.000.

R5.name: High-risk corridor
R5.how: Transfers to high-risk-tier countries within 30 days: at least €5.000 in total or at least 3 transfers.

R6.name: Purpose mismatch
R6.how: Declared purpose savings or family support, but at least 12 different counterparties within 30 days.
